tagline: Indonesian botanical body care for retail, hospitality and private-label collaboration.

story.title: Natural soap, rooted in Indonesian botanicals.
story.body: ARANOMIYA is presented in public trade and halal directories as a producer of natural soap/body cleanser. The founder’s public profile positions the business around herbal soap, shampoo bars and aromatherapy solutions using Indonesian botanical ingredients, with collaboration routes for hotels, spas, retailers, distributors and private-label partners.
